title: Lovely Crunchy Tunisian Lamb Kebabs
description: A pungent and crunchy Tunisian dish featuring beurre noisette and deglaze fond, perfect for crowds and diabetic friendly, this lamb kebab recipe is a crowd pleaser.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, butter, garlic, paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through.
While the kebabs are cooking, prepare the beurre noisette by melting the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Continue cooking the butter until it turns golden brown and has a nutty aroma.
Deglaze the saucepan with lemon juice, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Serve the kebabs hot, brushed with the beurre noisette and deglaze fond.
